Canino: Clearly #1 in our house!

We've tried 3-4 different brands of raw food for our dogs, and without a doubt, Canino is the clear winner! 🐶❤️

Canino is a Quebec brand, and it's honestly a great find.

What I particularly love is the square patty format. They're very easy to cut, even when still frozen, which makes portioning much simpler and allows you to easily calculate the amount given at each meal.

Visually, the difference is also striking. The meat has a beautiful color and texture, much more like ground beef than the brownish mush you find with some other brands. And above all, no unpleasant odor! For us, that's a huge advantage, because some other raw foods had a rather strong smell.

But the most important thing is obviously our dogs… and they seem to have voted unanimously! 😂 Since we started using Canino, we've noticed their coats are softer and shinier, and they've regained and maintained a healthy weight.

And the price? Canino at Costco is about half the price of many other brands you find at retailers like Mondou or Chico.

In short, when you combine quality, ease of use, appearance, scent, results on our dogs, and price, for us the choice is pretty simple:

🏆 Canino = number 1, hands down! 🐾

We’ve been extremely impressed with Canino Raw Dog Food. The quality of the ingredients is obvious, and it’s reassuring to know we’re feeding our dog a balanced, Canadian-made raw diet. Our dog absolutely loves every meal and gets excited the moment the package comes out of the freezer.

Since switching to Canino, we’ve noticed a shiny coat, healthy skin, great energy levels, and consistently firm stools. The food is easy to portion, thaws well, and the variety of protein options keeps mealtime interesting.

As dog owners, we appreciate a company that prioritizes quality, nutrition, and transparency. Canino has made feeding raw simple and convenient without compromising on ingredients. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for a premium raw food for their dog.
